findings.issue: HVti3ms of H2398 is hithpael (purify/cleanse oneself). «se pecará» keeps the qal sense of committing sin and reverses that stem force.
Same stem-force mismatch on the negated hithpael: לֹא + H2398 is not «no se pecará».

notes: Pronoun, בּוֹ, day+ordinal pairs, וְאִם, and qal H2891 «puro» match person, number, and participants.
